_doc: Correlated markets. links: target (market it applies to: slug | glob | slug:Outcome | token), other (related market: slug | slug:Outcome | token), relation (same | complement | linear | move | le | ge), alpha/beta (log-odds mapping for linear/move), noise_sd (log-odds sd of the relationship = how much you trust it), margin (prob slack for le/ge). event_sums: target, event (event slug; default its own), total (1 = exactly one leg wins, K = K legs win, 'auto'), residual_sd. Neg-risk events get total=1 automatically. Or use: py -m FairMV link <target> <other> --relation move --beta 0.8

links._why: same M&A climate: levels differ but news moves both
